notes.drag: carriage drag: none until a source gives one
notes.kind: a turbojet cruise missile, compiled as a bomb (the engine has no air-to-ground missile kind); the sim flies it as a GPS-guided weapon (sim)
notes.power: 30 kg warhead at 50 points a kilogram (our damage scale)
notes.blast_m: no public lethal radius found: 30 m held until one is
notes.model: none yet: no model of ours; the briefing shows our labelled silhouette (data/stores/delilah.png)
notes.generation: ours: the weapons.ibx section key (generation · 1000 + type) is one per weapon of a kind
notes.sim: the sim flies modern_weapons.gd's record 1012, built on this one, in its place (loadout::sim_load): the GPS-guided class (gps.rs) with its turbojet's cruise taken as a glide of ratio 23, which reaches the 250 km from its 8,500 m flight altitude at Mach 0.7, between Mach 0.3 and its Mach 0.85 dive (inferred); its CCD / IIR end seeker is not modelled (it lands on the point set at the release)
notes.mach: its top cruise speed (Wikipedia: Mach 0.3-0.7, Mach 0.85 in the dive)

footnotes.w-delilah: Wikipedia, "Delilah (missile)" (187 kg, 2.71 m, 0.33 m; 30 kg warhead; 250 km; Mach 0.3-0.7, Mach 0.85 in the dive; flight altitude 28,000 ft; CCD / IIR with GPS / INS), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Delilah_(missile)
